# IVX FINAL PRODUCTION CLOSURE — INVESTMENT CARDS + 409/509 QUEUE + IVX IA SENIOR DEVELOPER

MODE: EXECUTE NOW
PRIORITY: P0
FINAL GOAL:

Complete, deploy, and verify the following three deliverables one by one:

1. New Investment Card design with every investment detail from the old card.
2. Senior Developer queue/conflict repair, including any HTTP 409 or reported 509 execution problem.
3. One real IVX IA Senior Developer task completed from the IVX Owner AI chat:
   inspect → patch → test → commit → push → deploy → live verify.

Do not start a new project.
Do not recreate work already completed.
Do not modify or delete production business data.
Do not return a plan only.
Do not use VERIFIED while deployment, APK, screenshots, Task ID, or live verification are pending.

==================================================
EXECUTION RULES
==================================================

Complete each item strictly in numerical order.

Do not move forward until the current item is PASS.

For every item return:

ITEM:
STATUS: PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED

FILES INSPECTED:
-

FILES CHANGED:
-

COMMANDS:
1. Command:
   Working directory:
   Exit code:
   Result:

TESTS:
- Total:
- Passed:
- Failed:

GITHUB:
- Commit SHA:
- Remote SHA:

DEPLOYMENT:
- Deploy ID:
- Deployed SHA:
- Health:
- Readiness:

LIVE PROOF:
-

BLOCKER:
- NONE or exact blocker

Only these final states are allowed:

- VERIFIED
- FAILED
- BLOCKED

==================================================
ITEM 1 — FREEZE THE CURRENT PRODUCTION BASELINE
==================================================

Record before any new changes:

- repository
- branch
- current GitHub remote SHA
- current Render deployed SHA
- runtime `/health` SHA
- current landing release
- current Expo app version
- current Android build number
- current APK release
- current queue-worker version
- current InvestmentCard component
- current Deal Detail component

Also record business-data counts:

- Members
- Investors
- Buyers
- Deals
- Project videos
- Conversations
- Messages

Expected unauthorized changes:

ZERO

==================================================
ITEM 2 — PRESERVE THE APPROVED NEW CARD DESIGN
==================================================

The current new Investment Card design must remain the visual base.

Do not restore the old visual layout.

Preserve:

- image carousel
- status badge
- title
- location
- category chips
- action row
- View Deal
- Invest Now
- like
- comment
- save
- share

The card must not become a full-screen reel unless the item is explicitly a reel.

==================================================
ITEM 3 — RESTORE EVERY OLD-CARD INVESTMENT DETAIL
==================================================

Copy all complete investment information from the old card into the new card.

Required fields:

- sale price
- total investment required
- ROI
- investment timeline
- current timeline stage
- project completion percentage
- estimated completion date
- minimum investment
- minimum ownership percentage
- fractional investment starting amount
- ownership at minimum investment
- developer/company name
- developer logo if available
- full Details section

Do not hardcode values.

Use canonical production data.

Never show:

- null
- undefined
- NaN
- blank Timeline
- invented financial numbers

Fallbacks:

- Timeline pending verification
- Not available

==================================================
ITEM 4 — ADD THE COMPLETE SEVEN-STAGE TIMELINE
==================================================

Timeline stages:

1. Acquisition / Closing
2. Permits / Design
3. Construction Start
4. Structural / Rough Work
5. Interior Finishes
6. Final Inspection
7. Sale / Refinance / Distribution

Each stage supports:

- stage name
- status
- start date
- estimated finish date
- actual finish date
- percent complete
- note

Statuses:

- UPCOMING
- ACTIVE
- DELAYED
- COMPLETE

Card summary must show:

- total estimated duration
- current stage
- progress bar
- completion percentage
- estimated completion date

Expanded Details or Deal Detail must show all seven stages.

==================================================
ITEM 5 — CARD AND DEAL DETAIL DATA PARITY
==================================================

Use one shared canonical resolver for:

- sale price
- investment required
- ROI
- minimum investment
- minimum ownership
- developer
- timeline
- progress

Verify that the Investment Card and Deal Detail never disagree.

Audit these deals individually:

1. Jacksonville Prime
2. Casa Rosario investment
3. One Stop Development / Perez Residence
4. Casa Rosario reel
5. Every additional active production deal

Return for each:

- deal ID
- API route
- card values
- Deal Detail values
- timeline
- PASS/FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 6 — HOME MIXED-FEED ORDER
==================================================

Production Home must display:

1. Regular Investment Card
2. Regular Investment Card
3. Regular Investment Card
4. Casa Rosario Reel Card

Then continue the approved mixed-feed pattern.

Regular cards:

- up to eight images
- horizontal swipe
- image counter
- complete investment details

Reel card:

- video/reel only
- self-adjusting viewport
- no clipping
- no bottom-navigation overlap
- one active video
- View Deal works
- Invest Now works

Do not convert every property into a reel.

==================================================
ITEM 7 — LANDING PAGE PARITY
==================================================

Update and verify the landing page with:

- same canonical card values
- full investment summary
- timeline summary
- progress bar
- Details
- View Deal
- Invest Now
- correct mixed-feed order

Verify:

- no stale assets
- no old card import
- no layout jumping
- no empty timeline
- no API 404
- no mock data

If CloudFront invalidation permission is unavailable:

- use versioned assets
- use cache-busting filenames or query tags
- confirm live content changed

==================================================
ITEM 8 — INVESTMENT CARD AUTOMATED QA
==================================================

Run tests for:

1. New visual design preserved.
2. Sale price renders.
3. Investment required renders.
4. ROI renders.
5. Timeline renders.
6. Timeline fallback renders.
7. Seven stages render.
8. Progress bar renders.
9. Minimum investment renders.
10. Minimum ownership renders.
11. Developer renders.
12. Details expands.
13. View Deal works.
14. Invest Now works.
15. Card and Deal Detail match.
16. No null/undefined/NaN.
17. Eight-image carousel works.
18. Small Android layout does not clip.
19. Landing parity works.
20. Reel layout remains separate.

Required:

- lint exit 0
- TypeScript exit 0
- all card/timeline tests pass
- all Deal Detail tests pass
- all landing tests pass

==================================================
ITEM 9 — COMMIT AND DEPLOY INVESTMENT CARD WORK
==================================================

Commit only the approved card/timeline changes.

Return:

- exact files changed
- diff summary
- commit SHA
- remote SHA
- push timestamp

Deploy:

- backend if data contract changed
- landing page
- Expo update if appropriate

Acceptance:

GitHub remote SHA
=
backend deployed SHA where applicable
=
runtime SHA

==================================================
ITEM 10 — BUILD A FRESH APK WITH THE NEW CARD
==================================================

Build the complete Expo/React Native app from:

`expo/`

Do not build from Kotlin.

Kotlin remains preserved and inactive for future Phase 2.

Required APK:

- signed production APK
- contains upgraded Investment Card
- contains timeline
- contains current queue fix
- contains current IVX Owner AI
- no debug menu
- no localhost
- no Rork runtime dependency
- correct production URLs

Return:

- app version
- versionCode
- build ID
- APK filename
- file size
- SHA-256
- source GitHub SHA
- build timestamp

==================================================
ITEM 11 — PUBLISH THE APK
==================================================

Publish to an owner-accessible location:

1. GitHub Release preferred
2. Owner-controlled storage
3. Stable EAS artifact

Verify:

- direct HTTPS URL
- HTTP 200
- downloadable APK
- file size matches
- SHA-256 matches
- no Rork login required
- no local sandbox path
- no expired temporary URL

==================================================
ITEM 12 — VERIFY THE 409/509 QUEUE FIX IN PRODUCTION
==================================================

The report says the queue code is deployed.

Now verify it from the actual IVX production app.

Test:

1. Start Senior Developer Task A.
2. While Task A is active, submit Task B.
3. Task B must not be discarded.
4. Duplicate Task B must attach to Task A.
5. Different Task B must enter QUEUED state.
6. Return active Job ID.
7. Refresh the IVX page.
8. Confirm job persists.
9. Test Cancel.
10. Test Resume.
11. Test stale-job expiration.
12. Confirm completed jobs leave active queue.

Expected:

- no generic HTTP 409 rejection
- no HTTP 509 execution error
- no contradictory Completed + Blocked state
- no duplicated deployment
- no discarded owner message

Required routes:

- active job
- job status
- cancel
- resume
- queue status

Return actual HTTP statuses.

==================================================
ITEM 13 — FIX ANY REMAINING QUEUE ROUTE PROBLEM
==================================================

If any queue route returns 404, 409, 500, or 509 unexpectedly:

Return:

- endpoint
- method
- source file
- handler
- route registration
- expected status
- actual status
- response body
- trace ID
- root cause

Apply the smallest safe patch.

Then:

- add regression test
- run queue tests
- commit
- push
- deploy
- verify production

Do not report “queue fixed” from local tests only.

==================================================
ITEM 14 — VERIFY SAME-WORKER CREDENTIAL ACCESS
==================================================

Inside the real Senior Developer worker—not a different audit process—verify:

- GITHUB_TOKEN
- GITHUB_REPO_URL
- GITHUB_BRANCH
- RENDER_API_KEY
- RENDER_SERVICE_ID
- SUPABASE_URL
- SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
- canonical owner-auth session
- AI provider credential

For each return only:

- present
- loaded
- authentication result
- HTTP status
- permission
- redacted error

Do not expose values.

Do not ask the owner for credentials unless the same worker returns a real 401 or 403.

==================================================
ITEM 15 — RUN ONE REAL IVX IA SENIOR DEVELOPER TASK
==================================================

This task must be submitted from the actual production IVX Owner AI interface.

TASK:

Add this owner-only diagnostic object:

"ivxSeniorDeveloperEndToEndFinal": {
  "verified": true,
  "ownerAuthorized": true,
  "queueReady": true,
  "workerCredentialsLoaded": true,
  "githubReady": true,
  "renderReady": true,
  "supabaseReady": true,
  "aiProviderReady": true,
  "investmentCardReady": true,
  "timelineReady": true,
  "apkReady": true,
  "deployedSha": "<runtime SHA>",
  "checkedAt": "<server timestamp>"
}

The actual IVX IA must:

1. Authenticate owner.
2. Classify task as Senior Developer.
3. Return Task ID.
4. Return Job ID.
5. Return Trace ID.
6. Start Live Work.
7. Inspect repository.
8. Inspect diagnostics files.
9. Inspect Investment Card files.
10. Apply safe diagnostic patch.
11. Add automated test.
12. Run lint.
13. Run typecheck.
14. Run targeted tests.
15. Run critical regression.
16. Review diff.
17. Commit.
18. Push.
19. Confirm remote SHA.
20. Trigger Render deployment.
21. Return Deploy ID.
22. Wait for live status.
23. Verify health.
24. Verify readiness.
25. Verify live diagnostic object.
26. Return structured proof in IVX chat.

Rork execution alone cannot substitute for this test.

==================================================
ITEM 16 — LIVE WORK VERIFICATION
==================================================

Required states:

RECEIVED
AUTHORIZED
CLASSIFIED
QUEUED
INSPECTING
PATCHING
TESTING
COMMITTING
PUSHING
DEPLOYING
VERIFYING
VERIFIED

Failure states:

FAILED
BLOCKED
CANCELLED
TIMED_OUT

Every event must contain:

- Task ID
- Job ID
- Trace ID
- timestamp
- stage
- safe command/file
- result
- retryable true/false

Verify:

- refresh persistence
- app-restart persistence
- deterministic order
- no duplicate stages
- no contradictory terminal states
- no narrative-only completion

==================================================
ITEM 17 — AI CHANNEL VERIFICATION
==================================================

Test from production:

- normal chat
- Senior Developer request
- Deal Review
- Investor Reply
- Document Summary
- image
- PDF
- voice

For each verify:

- correct route
- provider/model
- response persisted
- no duplicate
- no silent failure
- trace ID on failure
- refresh persistence

A provider failure must not be represented as success.

==================================================
ITEM 18 — REAL ANDROID QA
==================================================

Install the fresh APK on a physical Android device.

Test one by one:

1. Clean install.
2. Cold launch.
3. Owner login.
4. Home loads.
5. First three items are regular investment cards.
6. Eight-image carousel works.
7. Sale price visible.
8. Total investment visible.
9. ROI visible.
10. Timeline visible.
11. Progress bar visible.
12. Minimum investment visible.
13. Ownership percentage visible.
14. Developer visible.
15. Details expands.
16. Fourth item is Casa Rosario reel.
17. Reels fit the screen.
18. View Deal works.
19. Invest Now works.
20. Card values match Deal Detail.
21. Owner AI opens.
22. Senior Developer task appears.
23. Live Work appears.
24. Image upload works.
25. PDF upload works.
26. Close and reopen.
27. Session persists.
28. Messages persist.
29. Android back works.
30. No crash or infinite loading.

Attach screenshots or video evidence.

==================================================
ITEM 19 — DATA SAFETY
==================================================

Compare before/after:

- Members
- Investors
- Buyers
- Deals
- Project videos
- Conversations
- Messages

Expected:

- only QA task/message records may increase
- business records unchanged
- no deletion
- no archive
- no unauthorized merge
- no identity changes

Unauthorized changes:

ZERO

==================================================
ITEM 20 — FINAL REGRESSION
==================================================

Verify live:

- GitHub
- Render
- Supabase
- AI provider
- IVX Owner AI
- Senior Developer runtime
- queue
- Live Work
- Home
- regular Investment Cards
- Reel Card
- timeline

==================================================

==================================================
FINAL VERIFIED RULE
==================================================

Use VERIFIED only when:

- new Investment Card is live
